action: In Edit Mode on the body object 'Cube', with the side reference behind the mesh, scales the selected ankle vertices flat on Z.

settings.Mirror modifier: Axis X, Clipping on, Merge on 0.001 m

view: Right Orthographic, Edit Mode, X-ray over reference image
why: Gives a flat base loop to start the shoe sole from
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.transform.resize(value=(1,1,0), orient_type='GLOBAL') on the selected verts

action: Extrudes a chain of vertices ten times to trace the side outline of the sole over the reference.
view: Right Orthographic, Edit Mode, X-ray over reference
why: Draws the sole profile point by point to match the drawing
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_vert_indiv / create verts at traced YZ coordinates and connect with edges

action: Fills faces between the traced sole vertices with F, two or more times.
why: Turns the outline into a flat side panel of the sole
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.mesh.edge_face_add() on each selected vertex pair/quad, or bmesh.ops.contextual_create

action: Moves sole vertices with G to sit on the reference outline, including the heel and the arch gap.
view: Right Orthographic, Edit Mode over reference
why: Matches the stepped heel and arch of the drawn sole
reader_equivalent: set v.co for the chosen vertices in bmesh

action: Switches to a rotated user view in wireframe and moves single sole vertices slightly to give the profile width in 3D.
why: Checks the flat profile from an angle and starts shaping it around the foot

action: Merges selected vertices at their center to close the sole ring.
why: Joins the ends of the sole strip so it wraps the foot

action: Shows the sole as a closed strip ring around the leg in solid shading.
why: Checks the ring shape of the sole

action: Selects the top edge loop of the sole shell, extrudes it in place and scales it in to make the inner rim.
tool: Extrude Region and Move (E) then Resize (S)
why: Gives the sole a rim thickness/inset where the upper sits

action: Back in the side view, extrudes vertices from the sole rim to start the shoe upper over the reference.
why: Builds the upper from the sole edge

action: Places upper vertices with G on the side reference, building a grid over the toe and instep.
why: Matches the drawn upper panels
reader_equivalent: bmesh vertex co edits on the YZ plane

action: Orbits to check the open upper shell from above in solid view.
why: Checks the 3D shape of the upper
reader_equivalent: render a viewport capture from a 3/4 angle

action: Selects a connected part of the upper with L, delimited by normal.
why: Selects the collar/upper piece to move it as one

action: Shift-selects vertices and merges them with M at the ankle collar.
why: Closes gaps between the upper and the collar

action: Moves single vertices on the toe box and tongue to round the upper.
why: Shapes the toe and opening

action: Moves two vertices on the instep in the side view.
why: Fits the upper line to the drawing

action: Extrudes the top of the collar upward along the leg.
why: Raises the boot collar to the ankle height in the drawing

action: In front view, moves the shoe sideways with proportional editing so it lines up under the leg; both shoes show because of the mirror.
why: Centers the shoe under the leg in front view

action: Keeps proportional editing on and moves verts of the shoe in wireframe from above.
why: Adjusts the footprint width smoothly

action: Fills seven holes with F, then adds one loop cut across the upper.
tool: Make Edge/Face (F), Loop Cut and Slide (Ctrl R)
why: Closes the shell and adds an edge loop for the upper panels

action: Moves vertices of the new loop in side view and checks the shoe from the back.
view: Right Orthographic over reference, then User Orthographic
why: Places the loop on the panel lines of the drawing

action: Selects an edge path around the ankle and extrudes it.
why: Starts the ankle strap band

action: Goes to Object Mode to look at the whole shoe shaded.
why: Checks the silhouette with the mirrored second shoe

action: Extrudes the strap faces and moves them slightly down to make the strap stand out from the shoe.
why: Gives the ankle strap thickness

action: Selects all shoe geometry and moves it in X in front view.
why: Purpose not clear from the frames; the shoe faces are selected as one block before separation

action: The shoe is now its own object Cube.001 (with its own Mirror modifier) and is nudged in X.
why: Keeps the shoe as a separate mesh from the body

action: Box-selects the bottom of the shoe in wireframe and scales it narrower on X.
why: Narrows the sole width

action: On Cube.001, extrudes the top loop of the shoe collar up the shin to below the knee.
why: Builds the red leg warmer tube from the shoe

action: Rotates the top ring of the warmer to match the slanted top edge in the side and front drawing.
view: Right Orthographic then Front Orthographic, X-ray over reference
why: The warmer top is cut at an angle in the reference
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.transform.rotate(value=radians(-14.6), orient_axis='X', orient_type='GLOBAL') for a right-view rotation

action: On the body Cube, bevels an edge loop at the knee.
why: Adds loops for the band at the top of the warmer

action: Adds another loop cut on the leg and rotates the selected loop to follow the slanted band.
tool: Loop Cut and Slide (Ctrl R), Rotate (R)
why: Puts edge loops on the knee band line
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(cuts=1) on the edge ring; bpy.ops.transform.rotate(value=radians(-12.2), orient_axis='Z')

action: Alt-clicks an edge loop at the knee band and scales it up uniformly.
why: Raises a ridge on the leg for the band/cuff
reader_equivalent: select the loop with bmesh edge-loop walk; bpy.ops.transform.resize(value=(1.084,)*3)

action: Moves knee loop vertices in the front view.
why: Matches the band width in front view

action: Cuts new edges on the shin with the Knife tool to follow the slanted edge of the warmer.

settings.status_bar: Cut, Close, Stop, Midpoint Snap, Ignore Snap, Cut Through, Angle Constraint

why: Adds edges where the color/shape boundary is

action: Moves cut vertices in side view to shape the diagonal edge and the cuff ridge.
why: Shapes the knee band and diagonal

action: On Cube.001, scales a small selected piece down uniformly.
why: Sizes a small part near the ankle (exact part not clear)

action: Adds a loop cut to the thin ankle ribbon piece and moves it up.
tool: Loop Cut and Slide (Ctrl R), Move
why: Bends the ribbon that sticks out from the ankle

action: Selects the ribbon piece with L twice and duplicates it with Shift D.
why: Makes a second ribbon tail

action: In Object Mode, sets Cube.001 to smooth shading with sharp edges kept.
why: Smooth look for the low-poly shoe

action: Saves the file and looks at the front reference with the shorts over the body wireframe.
view: Front Orthographic, Object Mode, X-ray over reference
why: Checkpoint before the shorts

action: On the body Cube, dissolves edges at the crotch.
why: Cleans crotch topology before the shorts are taken from it

action: Moves hip and thigh vertices to the shorts outline in the side view.
why: Fits the hips to the drawn shorts silhouette

action: Tweaks the hip, buttock and crotch vertices from right, back and 3/4 views with a front/back turnaround as reference.
view: Right, Back and User Orthographic, solid
why: Shapes the pelvis that the shorts will copy

action: Selects the body faces that the shorts cover (hips to upper thigh).
why: These faces become the shorts
reader_equivalent: select faces by position (z range around the pelvis)

action: The selected faces now exist as a new object Cube.002 (with Mirror modifier) and are moved slightly out from the body.

settings.status: Cube.002 Verts 48/48, Edges 85/85, Faces 37/37, Tris 72, Objects 1/5

why: Shorts start as a copy of the body surface

action: Edits Cube and Cube.002 together in multi-object Edit Mode and selects the waist loop.
why: Fits the shorts edge and the body together

action: Moves the hem vertices of the shorts down.
why: Sets the shorts leg length

action: Moves single shorts vertices around the crotch and hem in 3D.
view: User Orthographic and Front Orthographic, solid
why: Loosens the shorts off the skin and shapes the crotch gap

action: Adds a loop cut near the hem and slides it to the end.
why: Adds the loop for the rolled hem cuff
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(cuts=1) on the vertical edges near the hem, then move the new loop

action: Bevels the vertical side and front edges of the shorts; a hem cuff band is already visible.
why: Adds seam/panel lines for the colored side stripes

action: Separates the waistband faces with P into a new object Cube.003.

settings.status: Cube.003 Verts 0/20, Edges 0/28, Faces 0/9, Tris 18, Objects 1/6

why: Keeps the waistband as its own piece

action: Adds a loop cut across the waistband Cube.003.
why: Marks where the belt loops come off
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(cuts=1) on the waistband edge ring

action: Extrudes faces from the waistband down and out to form belt-loop flaps.
why: Belt loops seen on the reference

action: Rotates a loop piece slightly and checks the waistband and loops from the back.
why: Aligns the loop with the body curve

action: Selects a linked belt-loop piece and duplicates it to another spot on the waistband.
why: Repeats the belt loops around the waist

action: On the shorts Cube.002, selects the side faces where the drawn pockets are and extrudes them.
why: Starts the side pocket flaps

action: Uses the Knife and moves vertices to shape the side pocket.
why: Cuts the pocket outline

action: In face select mode, shift-selects the back pocket faces on each buttock.
why: Back pockets

action: The back pocket now stands out from the shorts; more Knife cuts and vertex moves shape the pocket and hip.
view: User Orthographic and Right Orthographic, solid
why: Pocket depth and outline
reader_equivalent: extrude faces, vert_connect_path, bmesh co edits

action: Starts the crop top as a new object Cube.004 that is only a horizontal line of 9 vertices across the chest just under the bust, with a Mirror modifier already on it.
tool: Edit Mode vertex/edge editing + Mirror modifier
why: Build the garment edge by edge on top of the body instead of from a primitive
reader_equivalent: bmesh: create a row of verts/edges at the under-bust height on x>=0, add MIRROR modifier use_clip=True merge_threshold=0.001

action: Switches to the side view with X-ray on and extrudes/moves edge rows to trace the outline of the bra-like crop top over the side reference image.
view: Right Orthographic, X-ray, reference image behind
why: Match the cup silhouette to the side concept
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_edge_only then translate new verts to traced profile coordinates

action: Moves a selection of under-cup vertices along X to tuck the band against the body.
why: Fit the band to the ribcage

action: Rotates a group of 4 cup vertices around the view axis so the cup edge follows the breast curve in side view.
why: Shape the cup outline to the reference
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.rotate(bm, verts=sel, cent=pivot, matrix=Matrix.Rotation(radians(36.3),3,'X')) (view Z in Right Ortho is world X)

action: Fills the cup as a quad grid wrapped over the breast and moves single vertices to sit just above the body surface.
why: Low-poly cup that hugs the body
reader_equivalent: translate individual verts; or shrinkwrap verts to body then offset along normal

action: Moves cup edge vertices outward along X to close the side of the cup.
why: Shape the outer side of the top

action: Selects the row of faces under the cups (the underband) in side X-ray view, then edge-slides a loop to set the band height.
view: Right Orthographic X-ray, then User Orthographic
why: Define the underband strip that becomes the belt

action: Duplicates the underband face row in place (Shift+D, cancel move) to start a separate band piece.
why: Make the under-bust belt as its own layer over the top

action: Removes the centre part so the band becomes two side blocks with a gap at the front, picking edges with Ctrl-click shortest path.
why: Leave room for the centre ornament

action: Moves the band's side edge inward; the band now has visible thickness faces on its edge.
why: Finish the band end

action: Pulls the top-centre vertex of the crop top down to make a V notch between the cups.
why: Match the V neckline of the concept
reader_equivalent: translate the centre vertex on x=0 down in Z

action: Adds a loop cut and shapes a diamond/gem piece at the front centre between the two band blocks.
why: Centre ornament of the top

action: Extrudes the diamond faces along their normal and scales them to give the ornament thickness.
why: Give the ornament depth
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_face_region then translate along face normal 0.0107 and scale 0.8315 about centre

action: Nudges the ornament forward in Y so it sits proud of the band.
why: Avoid z-fighting with the band

action: Opens the Snapping popover and sets the snap target from Increment to Face (Face Project), then turns snapping on.

settings.Snap Target: Face (cursor on Face; Increment was active)

why: Make new vertices land on the body surface

action: Extrudes single vertices from the top corners of the cups up toward the neck, drawing the line of the halter straps.
tool: Extrude Region and Move (vertex), snapping on
why: Lay out the strap path on the body
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_vert_indiv then place each new vert at closest point on body (bvhtree.find_nearest)

action: Turns the strap vertex lines into strap faces running over the chest to the back of the neck.
why: Build the halter straps
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_edge_only along strap edges, then translate

action: Selects the whole strap with Select Linked (delimit Normal) and adds a lengthwise loop cut down the strap.
tool: Select Linked, Loop Cut and Slide
why: Isolate the strap and give it a centre ridge

action: In wireframe X-ray selects the strap's edge loops and shapes the strap; result in Object Mode is crossing straps from the cups to the neck.
tool: Edge select, Move, Object Mode check
view: User Orthographic wireframe, then solid Object Mode
why: Clean strap shape and review
reader_equivalent: select edge loops by index and translate

action: Enters Edit Mode on the body (Cube) and Alt-clicks the top loop of the neck to start the collar from body geometry.
why: Base the collar on the neck ring so it fits
reader_equivalent: select the neck-top edge loop of the body mesh by Z height

action: A new object Cube.005 holds a ring around the neck (half-ring, mirrored); moves it out slightly.
why: Collar as its own object
reader_equivalent: duplicate neck faces then bpy.ops.mesh.separate(type='SELECTED'); translate

action: Extrudes the collar ring upward and scales the top loop down slightly to taper the stand collar.
why: High stand collar like the concept

action: Undoes several steps (Ctrl+Z x9) and selects front collar faces to rebuild the front flap.
why: Retry the collar front

action: Extrudes the lower front edge of the collar down onto the chest as a flap and lowers it.
why: Collar front panel that overlaps the straps
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_edge_only on bottom-front edges then translate down

action: Tweaks single vertices of the collar front panel into a pointed V shape.
why: V point of the collar flap

action: Uses the Knife tool to cut extra edges into the collar front panel.
why: Add edges for the V shape

action: In the body's Edit Mode with X-ray, circle-selects the upper torso and shoulder faces to copy into a jacket.
why: Start the jacket from body faces so it fits
reader_equivalent: select body faces whose centres are above chest height

action: The copied faces are now a separate object Cube.006 (jacket shell) shown in Object Mode.
why: Jacket as separate object

action: Cube.006 is cut down to a small shoulder piece (15 verts, 9 faces) and its top edge is moved over the shoulder.
why: Keep only the shoulder yoke to extend into the jacket
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.delete unwanted faces, translate border verts

action: Rotates the arm-hole edge of the jacket to follow the arm angle in the T/A pose.
why: Align the sleeve opening with the arm
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.rotate around Y (front view axis) by 40.2 deg

action: Extrudes the arm-hole loop down the arm to make the sleeve.
why: Long sleeve over the arm

action: Scales the sleeve end loop, adds loop cuts and rotates them to follow the flared sleeve in the reference.
tool: Resize, Loop Cut and Slide, Rotate
why: Bell sleeve shape
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.scale end loop; bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges ring cuts=1; bmesh.ops.rotate

action: Moves the sleeve end loop to the wrist position.
why: Place the cuff at the wrist

action: Extrudes a narrower cuff from the bottom of the puffed sleeve and moves it into place.
why: Gathered cuff under the puffed sleeve
reader_equivalent: extrude end loop, scale inward, translate

action: Adds loop cuts on the cuff (Ctrl+R, then Ctrl+Z x2) and checks the full figure.
view: Front Orthographic X-ray, then User Orthographic
why: Cuff detail

action: Moves sleeve vertices in front X-ray view and scales a new loop cut on the sleeve.
why: Refine the puffed sleeve profile
reader_equivalent: translate verts; subdivide ring; scale new loop by 0.941

action: Moves a single jacket vertex near the armpit/front edge.
why: Shape the open jacket front edge

action: Cuts new edges with the Knife across the jacket shoulder/upper sleeve.
view: Front Orthographic X-ray, then User Orthographic wireframe
why: Add edge flow for the sleeve seam
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.connect_verts / bisect_plane on the sleeve faces

action: Moves a vertex on the jacket front edge outward.
why: Open jacket silhouette

action: Scales a sleeve edge loop down.
why: Taper the sleeve

action: Selects the inner end loop of the cuff to close the sleeve opening.
why: Prepare to cap the cuff

action: Merges the selected cuff end loop At Center to close the sleeve end.
why: Close the hand opening of the low-poly sleeve

action: Raises an edge on the jacket front, then reviews the whole jacket in Object Mode against the front reference.

why: Check silhouette

action: Selects vertex rows across the sleeve in X-ray front view.
why: Pick edges for a crease

action: Bevels selected sleeve edges into two edges to add a fold line on the puffed sleeve.
why: Fold detail on the sleeve

action: Moves single vertices on the sleeve to shape the puff and its folds.
why: Puff silhouette

action: Shift-selects sleeve faces/verts from the back side to continue shaping.
why: Edit back of sleeve

action: Switches the reference image to the side/back turnaround and reviews the jacket in Object Mode.

why: Model the back of the jacket from the back view

action: Works on the jacket back: moves an edge loop and moves extruded vertices to outline a back panel.
why: Back panel shape

action: Moves a back edge loop of the jacket in Y.
why: Keep the jacket off the body

action: Edits the collar Cube.005 at the back: rotates collar vertices in side view so it leans back.
why: Collar back follows neck

action: Small vertex nudges on the collar base.
why: Close gap between collar and jacket

action: Extrudes the jacket's back hem edges downward to make the back drop; the centre back stays open in a vertical slot.
why: Long back panel of the jacket

action: Vertex-slides points along the back edges.
why: Adjust the back panel edge

action: Reviews the jacket from the side in Object Mode (Shift+N appears on the key overlay, probably a normals recalculation just before).
why: Check side silhouette and normals

action: Selects faces on the outer upper arm of the sleeve and adds a loop cut there.
why: Edges for the upper-arm patch

action: Scales the new upper-arm loop/patch down and cuts its outline with the Knife.
why: Shape the patch/strap on the upper sleeve

action: Bevels an edge of the upper-arm patch to a narrow double edge.
why: Crisp edge on the patch
